Both hands pull a short black sock over the left heel toward her toes; the sock is still around the front of the foot, leaving the heel and ankle visible. Her right foot still wears a black ankle boot and rests on the floor. The removed matching left boot stands beside the seat. Her face remains large, clearly readable and sharply resolved in the upper center. A complete coherent figure with two legs, two feet and two hands; skirt covers her lap naturally.
